extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF figures, captions, semithin/TEM results, and conclusions; not a worker-5 expansion beyond local evidence.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: R9F2 and (KFF)3K against Candida albicans CEMTC 34
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both peptides suppressed C. albicans hyphal growth and produced antifungal MIC/MFC activity; this is direct antifungal activity, not proof of a molecular target by itself.

source_locator.supports: Results text and Supplementary Table S1 support antifungal and hyphal-growth activity.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity endpoints do not identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: (KFF)3K produced earlier and more destructive plasma-membrane-associated ultrastructural changes, with vacuole and cell-wall changes appearing in the TEM/semithin time course.

source_locator.supports: Primary figure captions/results/conclusions localize peptide-associated morphology to plasma membrane, vacuole, and cell wall structures.

mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM morphology localizes structural damage but cannot resolve the chemical molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: R9F2 also affected the plasma membrane but with later and different ultrastructural manifestations than (KFF)3K; normal-looking cells persisted at early time points.

source_locator.supports: Primary results and conclusions compare R9F2 timing and morphology against (KFF)3K.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence supports morphological sequence and location, not a specific biochemical target or pathway.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper explicitly frames TEM as morphology/dynamics evidence and notes molecular interactions are not directly observed by these methods.
Figure panels support qualitative ultrastructural localization; exact panel-level percentages were not invented.
